name: Isabelle Dubois
bio:
Isabelle's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during her university days, volunteering at a local karting track to fund her engineering studies. What started as a means to an end quickly ignited a passion for the intricacies of racing technology. After graduating, she honed her skills at smaller racing teams, steadily climbing the ranks and earning a reputation for meticulousness and problem-solving acumen.

As Technical Director for Speed Kart Racing, Isabelle emphasizes a data-driven approach to kart setup and maintenance. She believes in empowering her team through clear communication and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. While demanding, her focus remains on maximizing performance through innovative solutions and rigorous attention to detail. Her calm demeanor under pressure has often proven crucial in high-stakes situations, allowing the team to make critical adjustments effectively.

physical.description: Isabelle has a serious, focused look, accentuated by her sharp features and piercing blue eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even on race days.
Has a habit of tapping her pen on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on a meticulously organized workspace, even in the chaos of the paddock.
